plot_dist_master: create weighted distribution comparison plots across multiple DataFrames using plotly, seaborn, or ASCII output
seaborn_plot_dist: build seaborn bar, histogram, kde, ecdf, or qq plots comparing weighted distributions of multiple variables
plotly_plot_dist: create interactive plotly qq and bar plots comparing weighted distributions of categorical and numeric variables
plot_hist_kde: build weighted histogram, kde, or ecdf distribution plots for a single column across multiple DataFrames
plot_qq: create weighted quantile-quantile scatter plots comparing sample distributions against a target distribution
